name: Minamiminowa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Minamiminowa village emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a stylised mountain and a character.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiminowa, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 September 1974.

features.role: Minamiminowa village emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised mountain and a character
